recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有大量單核樣胚細胞與前單核球，箭頭所指細胞的細胞質含粗大深紫色顆粒，混合嗜伊紅與嗜鹼性染色特性（abnormal eosinophils），右側另見一顆布滿深色粗顆粒的細胞，符合 inv(16) AML 的異常嗜伊紅球。
features: Increased blasts and promonocytes with folded, indented nuclei and fine chromatin
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with fine granules
Abnormal eosinophils with large dark purple (basophilic-staining) granules admixed with eosinophilic granules (arrows)
A cell densely packed with coarse dark granules at right
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular population dominated by blasts and promonocytes with folded or indented nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm. Scattered abnormal eosinophils contain large, dark purple basophilic-staining granules mixed with eosinophilic granules (arrows). Maturing neutrophils are sparse. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22); CBFB-MYH11.

ddx.vs: AMML NOS lacks the abnormal eosinophils with large basophilic granules and is negative for CBFB-MYH11.
Basophilic blasts have metachromatic granules without eosinophilic granules and are CD123/CD203c positive, whereas inv(16) abnormal eosinophils are chloroacetate esterase positive.
t(8;21) AML shows large blasts with a single long Auer rod, salmon-colored cytoplasm and maturing neutrophils with dysplasia rather than monocytic differentiation with abnormal eosinophils.
